fields.finding: Intact Be bulk ambient-gas permeation is set to zero in the screen, not measured. AF full-area bonds are behind Be and do not see the full exterior-to-interior gradient. The outer 30:1 scarf is screened at an assumed 10 Barrer; its adhesive is the 028 70 g/m2 route, not silently replaced with AF163.
fields.proposed_next: Measure scarf and metal/adhesive assembly permeance, pinholes and surface defects. Validate the actual panel boundary path.
